submission.justification: G2 gives the best time resolution of the three mixtures at every gap tested (about 0.88-1.06 ns, against 1.27-1.51 for G1 and 2.08-2.27 for G3). The G2 optimum lies in the 1.5-2.0 mm range. The first scan put the minimum at 1.5 mm (0.881 ns). Reruns changed that: 1.5 mm gave 0.984 (mean 0.9325), 1.7 mm gave 0.899 (mean 0.9055) and 2.0 mm gave 0.897. The three gaps are within noise of each other. I chose 2.0 mm because it has the lowest value in the reruns. Compliance with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies is NOT verified. No policy documents were found, so G2 may not be allowed. This must be checked by a person before G2 is adopted.

requirements.evidence: G2 is best of the three mixtures. At 2.0 mm it gives 0.897 ns, reproduced on rerun. Gaps of 1.5-2.0 mm are statistically indistinguishable (1.5 mm mean 0.9325, 1.7 mm mean 0.9055).
